description: Global typography utility classes from sherpa-text-classes.css. Apply to any HTML element. Always add index.css to the page — these classes live in layer(utilities.text). Use these instead of writing font-size/weight/line-height inline or in custom CSS.

notes: Requires index.css on the page: <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/styles/index.css">. Classes live in @layer utilities.text.
Use text-h1–text-h5 for headings, text-body for paragraphs, text-label for form labels — never write font-size/weight inline.
text-body (14px) is the default for most UI text. Use text-body-sm (12px) for secondary/metadata. Use text-body-lg (16px) for introductory paragraphs.
Monospaced classes (text-mono-*) are for code, tokens, IDs, timestamps — anything needing fixed-width characters.
text-label-group and text-title-component include secondary color automatically. Do not override their color.
font-* weight utilities are modifiers — combine with a text-* class to change weight without changing scale: <span class="text-body font-bold">
All classes consume --sherpa-font-* tokens which resolve through the alias layer — they adapt to density changes automatically.
